description: Ex-Aeronautique navale anti-submarine aircraft standing on a plinth on the rond-point Albert-Bignon since the 1990s, opposite the entrance to the former BAN Rochefort (now the gendarmerie school). It took part in Operation Mousquetaire during the 1956 Suez crisis and served with escadrille 4F aboard the Clemenceau in 1965-66. State-owned; in March 2025 the ministry of the armed forces handed its upkeep to the town of Rochefort for 30 years, with annual cleaning and a repaint every three to four years done with ANAMAN. A commemorative plaque was fixed to the plinth on 26 September 2007.
museum_name: Alizé du Rond-Point de l'Avion, Rochefort
